title: Geometry
summary: Angles, parallel lines, triangles and quadrilaterals, the angle sum of a triangle, symmetry, reflections, rotations, translations, solids and nets.

cards.title: Points, lines and angles
cards.rule: Acute under 90°, right 90°, obtuse 90° to 180°, straight 180°, reflex over 180°.

cards.title: Adjacent and opposite angles
cards.rule: On a straight line, angles add to 180°. Vertically opposite angles are equal.
lines: 130° on a straight line: the other angle is **50°**

cards.title: Parallel lines
cards.rule: Corresponding angles are equal (F), alternate angles are equal (Z), co-interior angles add to 180° (C).

cards.title: Compound problems
cards.rule: Draw an extra parallel line through the angle to split it.
lines: Parts of 40° and 30°: the whole angle is **70°**

cards.title: Triangles
cards.rule: By sides: equilateral, isosceles, scalene. By angles: acute, right, obtuse.

cards.title: Quadrilaterals and polygons
cards.rule: Square, rectangle, parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium, kite.

cards.title: Angle sum of a triangle
cards.rule: The angles of a triangle add to 180°.
lines: Isosceles with top angle 40°: each base angle is **70°**

cards.title: Symmetry
cards.rule: Line symmetry: it folds onto itself. Rotational symmetry: it fits onto itself as it turns.

cards.title: Reflection and rotation
cards.rule: Reflection: a mirror image. Rotation: a turn about a centre.
lines: Give a rotation's centre, angle and direction, such as 90° clockwise

cards.title: Translation
cards.rule: A slide, with no turning or flipping.

cards.title: Drawing solids
cards.rule: Prisms, pyramids, cylinders, cones and spheres.
lines: Draw top, front and side views
Isometric dot paper makes 3D drawing easier

cards.title: Nets of solids
cards.rule: A net folds up into the solid.
